acceptance_note: A x epsilon is profiled inside the fit: every theory variation member is renormalised to the same sigma(60 < m_LHE < 120) (fitting/CONVENTIONS.md section 3), so PDF / QCDScale / PS_ISR / PS_FSR vary only the acceptance, per region. There is no A_unc block here on purpose -- adding Acc_* parameters on top would double count.
